name: CBOR / MessagePack Inspector
description: Offline CBOR (RFC 8949) and MessagePack payload inspector: collapsible type tree, byte ranges with raw hex, offset diagnostics; preserves big integers, -0 and non-finite floats
help: Pick CBOR or MessagePack explicitly — the format is never guessed from "it parsed"; input is a local binary file or pasted Hex/Base64.
Only a single top-level value is parsed; trailing bytes are reported separately and a multi-value stream is never silently turned into an array.

Integers vs floats, bytes vs strings, null vs undefined are kept apart; big integers (tag 2/3), -0 and non-finite floats survive; maps keep ordered key/value pairs — non-string keys stay typed and duplicate keys are all kept with a warning.

CBOR shows tags, simple values, indefinite lengths and chunking; MessagePack shows str/bin, ext types with raw payloads; only the timestamp (-1) extension is explained. The report is this tool's diagnostic format, not a lossless JSON conversion.

input.empty: Choose a source and press Inspect
